## Goal
Fix locale-aware JPY minor-unit rounding in `ledgerly/money.py`; then resume PDF queue migration.

## Constraints and rules
Use `structlog`, never `print()` or stdlib logging. Keep commits small. Never edit `config/ledgerly.toml` without posting its diff in `#billing-config` for `@maya`. Run avatar migration sequentially. Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is obsolete.

## Key decisions and facts
SQLAlchemy modernization, billing session injection, repository imports, invoice subquery pagination, and avatar PNG/JPG sync are complete. Logging includes request IDs and structured invoice/payment events. Scheduler recurrence now combines scheduled local date/time with the schedule timezone before converting to UTC.

## Ruled out
Increasing Celery visibility timeout. PDF queue migration and legacy factory migration remain paused/out of scope.

## Progress
Scheduler fix and two DST regression tests added. Exact results: `pytest tests/test_scheduler.py tests/test_billing.py -q` → **31 passed**; `ruff check ...` → **All checks passed!**; `git diff --check` → clean. Full suite: **186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed**. Failure is `test_rounding_legacy_currency`: expected 1000, got 1001. Existing `tests/test_rounding.py`: **6 passed**. `billing/currency.py` uses hard-coded two-place `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Next steps
Inspect `ledgerly/money.py` and related currency code/tests; implement locale/minor-unit-aware JPY formatting without disturbing legacy behavior. Then run focused and full tests, review current diffs, and commit logical batches.
